'''Dicoh Mariam''' (1944 – 5 June 2024) was an Ivorian chemist.<ref>{{cite news |last= |first= |date=5 June 2024|title=Côte d'Ivoire : Décès de Mariam Dicoh, la chimiste dont le visage est matérialisé sur les pièces de monnaie de 25 F CFA|trans-title= |url=https://lefaso.net/spip.php?article130736|language=French|work=Lefaso.net|location= |access-date=6 June 2024}}</ref> She was the first woman chemist in the [[Ivory Coast]], and her image is found on the 25 [[CFA franc]] coin holding a [[burette]].<ref>{{cite news |last= |first= |date=1 October 2014|title=Une Chimiste dans vos portefeuilles / A Chemist in Your Purse|trans-title= |url=https://afrolegends.com/2014/10/01/une-chimiste-dans-vos-portefeuilles-a-chemist-in-your-purse/|language=French|work=African Heritage|location= |access-date=6 June 2024}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last1=Coller|first1=B.S.|last2=Gralnick|first2=H.R.|date=15 November 1975|title=Proceedings: Variations in quantitative ristocetin platelet aggregation (RPA) with time after platelet rich plasma (PRP) preparation: association with alteration in pH|trans-title=|url=https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/809/|language=|work=Thrombosis Et Diathesis Haemorrhagica|location=|access-date=6 June 2024|archive-date=6 June 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240606163024/https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/809/|url-status=live}}</ref>

==Biography==
Born in [[Abidjan]] in 1944, Mariam earned her [[Certificat d'études primaires]] in the early 1960s. She decided to continue her secondary studies during a time in which most women did not complete their studies to become midwives or secretaries. She was one of only two women in her secondary school classes and enjoyed the support of her parents in getting through her studies.<ref name="Tube">{{cite web|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RJRmbHogc4I|title=La Grande Interview Mme Konan Dicoh Mariam 1iere chimiste de Côte d'Ivoire (Guillaume Soro TV)|date=13 May 2015|work=YouTube|language=French}}</ref>

Mariam appeared on [[Guillaume Soro]]'s [[YouTube]] channel and explained the origin of the photograph that got her engraved on the 25 CFA franc coin.<ref name="Tube"/> One of her friends took the photo in Mariam's laboratory, which appeared in the magazine ''10 ans de progrès après l’indépendance'' in the 1970s. The photograph then coincidentally ended up in the hands of the [[Central Bank of West African States]]. Her friend Léonard Kalmogo, who was [[Minister of Finance (Burkina Faso)|Minister of Finance of Upper Volta]], then called her to inform her of the image appearing on the coin.<ref>{{cite news|last=|first=|date=8 January 2019|title=[Hommage]: Mariam Konan née Dicoh|trans-title=|url=http://miirya.com/2019/01/08/hommage-mariam-konan-nee-dicoh/|url-status=dead|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20220627181550/http://miirya.com/2019/01/08/hommage-mariam-konan-nee-dicoh/|archivedate=27 June 2022|language=French|work=miirya.com|location=|access-date=6 June 2024}}</ref>

Mariam also became owner of a restaurant called Gorge d'Or.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://abidjanresto.net/GORGE%20DOR.html|title=La Gorge d'Or|work=AbidjanResto.net|language=French|url-status=dead|archiveurl=https://archive.wikiwix.com/cache/index2.php?url=https%3A%2F%2Fabidjanresto.net%2FGORGE%2520DOR.html#federation=archive.wikiwix.com&tab=url|archivedate=24 February 2022}}</ref> Until 2015, she had not received any compensation from the Central Bank of West African States. One of her sons, {{ill|Jean-Luc Konan|fr}}, became director-general of the [[United Bank for Africa]] for Senegal for three years.<ref>{{cite news |last= |first= |date=18 March 2018|title=[Hommage]: Mariam Konan née Dicoh|trans-title= |url=https://radiomiirya.wordpress.com/2018/03/18/hommage-mariam-konan-nee-dicoh/|language=French|work=Radio Miirya|location= |access-date=6 June 2024}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last=|first=|date=18 August 2014|title=Qui est cette personne immortalisée sur nos pièces de 25 FCFA ?|trans-title=|url=https://www.dakaractu.com/Qui-est-cette-personne-immortalisee-sur-nos-pieces-de-25-FCFA_a73152.html|language=French|work=Dakaractu|location=|access-date=6 June 2024|archive-date=6 June 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240606163024/https://www.dakaractu.com/Qui-est-cette-personne-immortalisee-sur-nos-pieces-de-25-FCFA_a73152.html|url-status=live}}</ref>

Mariam died on 5 June 2024.<ref>{{cite news|last=|first=|date=5 June 2024|title=Décès à 80 ans de Mariam Dicko, première femme chimiste de Côte d'Ivoire dont le visage figure sur la pièce de 25 FCFA|trans-title=|url=https://livoirienexpress.com/actualite/deces-a-80-ans-de-mariam-dicko-premiere-femme-chimiste-de-cote-divoire-dont-le-visage-figure-sur-la-piece-de-25-fcfa.html|language=French|work=L'Ivoirien Express|location=|access-date=6 June 2024|archive-date=5 June 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240605115730/https://livoirienexpress.com/actualite/deces-a-80-ans-de-mariam-dicko-premiere-femme-chimiste-de-cote-divoire-dont-le-visage-figure-sur-la-piece-de-25-fcfa.html|url-status=live}}</ref>
